name: CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-1
cards.audioText: Your call sign is CSN421. You are just over ZF and maintaining 4500m. You are about to enter the Area Control airspace. Make an initial contact with Wuhan Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是南航421，刚过ZF，4500米保持。你即将进入区域管制空域。和武汉区调进行初次联系。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN421, over ZF, maintaining 4500m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航421，过ZF，4500米保持。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-2
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN421, request climb to 8900m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航421，请求爬升8900米。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-3
cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Control, radar contact, climb and maintain 7500m initially, expect 8900m able at time 16.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉区调，雷达已识别，起始爬升保持7500米，预计16分能到达8900米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Climb and maintain 7500m, 8900m able at time 16, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升保持7500米，预计16分能到达8900米，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-4
cards.audioText: Inform the controller that you have encountered a severe Clear Air Turbulence, and ask for 8900m.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知管制员你遇到了强烈的晴空乱流，请求爬升至8900米。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Control, CSN421, we have encountered a severe clear air Turbulence, request 8900m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉区调，南航421，我们遇到了强烈的晴空乱流，请求爬升8900米。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-5
44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-6
cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Control, is there any damage to the aircraft or passenger injuries?[Tell the controller that there isn't any damage, and the purser told you that passengers are OK.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉区调，飞机有损伤么？乘客有受伤么？【告诉管制员飞机没有任何损伤，乘务长说乘客也没受伤。】
cards.referenceText: No damage and the purser reported that the passengers are OK, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 没有损伤，乘务长说乘客也都很安全，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-7
cards.audioText: Inform Wuhan Control that you have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 通知武汉区调你刚接到匿名电话称机上有炸弹。
cards.referenceText: (Mayday Mayday Mayday) Wuhan Control, CSN421, we have just received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board.
cards.referenceTextZh: (Mayday Mayday Mayday) 武汉区调，南航421，我们刚接到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-8
cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, report your intentions.[Tell the controller that you wish to land at Wuhan airport.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，报告意图。【告诉管制员你希望降落在武汉机场。】
cards.referenceText: Request to land at Wuhan airport. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求降落在武汉机场，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-9
cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, turn left direct to ZF, descend to 4800m.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，左转直飞ZF，下降4800米。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to ZF, descend to 4800m, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞ZF，下降到4800米，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-10
cards.audioText: CSN421, do you need any assistance.[Inform the controller that you need a bomb disposal squad upon landing, and you will use the emergency slides to deplane the passengers.]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，你是否需要援助。【通知管制员，飞机降落时需要一支排弹小组，同时你会打开紧急逃生滑梯让乘客离机。】
cards.referenceText: We will use the emergency slides for evacuation, and we need a bomb disposal squad ready on arrival. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们会使用紧急逃生滑梯疏散乘客，到达时需要一支排弹小组，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-11
cards.audioText: CSN421, roger, maintain 4800m, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，收到，4800米保持，联系武汉进近118.9。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Maintaining 4800m, contact Wuhan Approach on 118.9, CSN421.

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-12
cards.audioText: Make an initial contact with Wuhan Approach; inform the controller that you have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board your aircraft, and you are returning to Wuhan.
cards.audioTextZh: 和武汉进近进行初次联系；通知管制员你收到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹，你正在返回武汉。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, CSN421, maintaining 4800m, over ZF. We have received an anonymous call saying there is a bomb on board. We are turning back to land at Wuhan airport.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南航421，4800米保持，过ZF。我们收到匿名电话，称飞机上有炸弹，我们正在返回降落到武汉。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-13
cards.audioText: CSN421, Wuhan Approach, radar contact, follow ZF-1A arrival; descend and maintain 2700m on QNH1017, information C.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，武汉进近，雷达已识别，ZF-1A进场；下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1017，通播C。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: ZF-1A arrival, descend and maintain 2700 m on QNH 1017; information C. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: ZF-1A进场，下降保持修正海压2700米，修正海压1017，通播C，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-14
cards.audioText: CSN421, descend and maintain 900m, expect ILS approach runway 36R.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，下降保持900米，预计盲降进近跑道36右。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Descend and maintain 900m, ILS approach runway 36R. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 下降保持900米，盲降进近跑道36右，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-15
cards.audioText: CSN421, reduce speed to 200 knots, turn right heading 330.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，速度减至200节，右转航向330。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Reduce speed to 200 knots; turn right heading 330, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 速度减至200节，右转航向330，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-16
cards.audioText: CSN421, intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 南航421，切入跑道36右航道，建立后报告。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Intercept the localizer of runway 36R, report established, CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 切入跑道36右航向道，建立后报告，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-17
cards.audioText: Inform the controller that you have captured the signal of the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 【通知管制员你已截获航向道信号。】
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，南航421，航道已建立。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-18
cards.audioText: Roger, CSN421, cleared ILS approach runway 36R, 13 miles from touch down, radar service terminated, contact Wuhan Tower on 124.35.[Read Back]
cards.audioTextZh: 收到，南航421，可以盲降进近跑道36右，距离着陆13海里，雷达服务中止，联系武汉塔台124.35。【复诵】
cards.referenceText: Cleared ILS approach runway 36R, Wuhan Tower 124.35. CSN421.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以盲降进近跑道36右，武汉塔台124.35，南航421。

cards.taskTitle: 44. CSN421 · 晴空颠簸与炸弹威胁-19
cards.audioText: Later, you cannot see the runway at decision altitude during approach, inform tower controller that you need to make another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 过了一会儿，在决断高度你无法看到跑道，通知塔台管制员你需要重新进近。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, CSN421, we are going around, no contact at minima.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，南航421，我们复飞了，最低标准不能见跑道。
